verdict.rationale: CoreWeave ships a Mission Control Agent, so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The pack only documents a first-party Mission Control MCP server, which is the server role and does not show the product connecting to user-supplied MCP servers. No evidence shows CoreWeave's agent or platform can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
